headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 20, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins suffered a blowout loss to the Cleveland Guardians, while the New York Yankees secured a comeback victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, and the Boston Red Sox edged the Baltimore Orioles in a closely contested matchup.

Top MLB news saw the Twins fall to the Guardians in a 13-4 loss, with Petey Halpin leading the Guardians' offense. The Yankees secured an 8-5 victory over the Pirates, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the Pirates' offense. The Rays took down the Blue Jays 7-1, with Nick Fortes hitting a home run. The Red Sox rallied past the Orioles 6-5, with Christian Encarnacion-Strand leading the Orioles' offense.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, with Max Meyer being placed on the 15-day injured list due to a neck strain. Phil Maton has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right knee tendinitis, while Miguel Andujar has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right wrist fracture. Adley Rutschman has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 19, 2026, with left wrist inflammation.

The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen in a trade with the Colorado Rockies, sending right-handed pitchers Nick Frasso and outfielder Landyn Vidourek to the Rockies. The Chicago Cubs have acquired right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale in a trade with the Athletics, sending right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett to the Athletics. The Baltimore Orioles have acquired right fielder Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals in exchange for cash.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall to Guardians in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins suffered a 13-4 loss to the Cleveland Guardians, with the Guardians' offense dominating the game. Petey Halpin led the Guardians' charge with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Yankees in 8-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-8 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the Pirates' offense with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs. Wilber Dotel impressed on the mound with 3 scoreless innings, striking out 5 batters.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Blue Jays 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Nick Fortes leading the offense. Fortes hit a home run on a fly ball to left center field, contributing to the team's strong performance.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Rally Past Orioles in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox edged the Baltimore Orioles 6-5 in a closely contested matchup. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Max Meyer Placed on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Miami Marlins right-hander Max Meyer has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a neck strain, effective retroactive to July 19, 2026.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Acquire RHP Seth Halvorsen in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen in a trade with the Colorado Rockies. Halvorsen joins the Dodgers in exchange for right-handed pitchers Nick Frasso and outfielder Landyn Vidourek.
